basic_mcp.failure: Expected paper absent from exposed initial candidate pool. Agent read another item, then a second fetch was suppressed for exceeding remaining raw-wire budget. Reformulations were intentionally unavailable in this frozen-vector experiment.

public_access.titans: Agent did not locate title in expected alphabetical range; a separate post-journey local catalog check confirms no matching title among 415 records. This is a catalog absence, not an agent retrieval error.
public_access.web_result: Instructions found in GitHub; both observed Pages guide and llms.txt URLs were inaccessible through the web retrieval tool; search fallback empty. Cause unknown, not proof the endpoint was down.

positive_title_attempt.reason: Outer tool truncated initial output; exact delivered size and compliance with the 24000-character budget cannot be certified.

interpretation: Existing advanced navigation recovered evidence on this small deterministic development selection. This does not establish general accuracy, new-query quality, other models, external MCP clients, public deployment or Cloudflare Free viability. No multiple-passage A/B is justified by the 12 REST outcomes. Basic MCP and REST comparison is descriptive only: tools, pools, reading granularity and raw serialization differ.
trace_caveat: Baseline 01 original server log lacks a search-response row. A separately transcribed actual tool output matches reported 4919 code points / 4921 bytes. The original is untouched; its support grade uses a later complete-paper response. No rerun was substituted.
